title: A global admission precedes transfer of any actual negative field
statement: Let H be a homogeneous quartic on Sym(2),H_doubleprime(X)[R,R]>=c|X|^2|R|^2 for EVERY symmetric X and symmetric rank-one R,c>0, and||H_doubleprime(X)||<=C|X|^2. D=C+2C^2/c. For ANY nu>0,mu>=CD/(6nu) makes H(sym A)+nu(b-c)^2+mu|A|^6 globally ROC at EVERY background/rank-one direction. The compatible rank-one decomposition R0=(u dot xi)xi tensor xi,W=symR-R0 has|W|<=|L(R)|; local ball and exterior sextic domination cover all A. Given strict actual Hessian gap -delta at symmetric mean M and actual smooth G=D2psi, vector potential epsilon gradpsi yields exact gap -delta epsilon^4+mu B epsilon^6,B=<|M+G|^6>-|M|^6>=0. Explicit small rational epsilon gives a genuine gradient negative; no such source violation found. Conic H can first strictify by eta|S|^4 preserving a strict negative. Three exact 9x9 Gram seeds receive only their actual conic premise; numerical square-tangent proposals lack separate global admission. Producer-identified prior art during a NEW ACTIVE continuation:Dal Maso,Fonseca,Leoni and Morini,2003,Higher order quasiconvexity reduces to quasiconvexity,arXiv math/0305138. At the supplied primary abstract statement scope,smooth strictly2-quasiconvex functions with p-growth,p>1,extend from symmetric matrices to classical quasiconvex functions with the SAME growth. The parent says it will use this degree-preserving result as a known tool. This is not independent priority adjudication or a new completed coupled result. It does NOT identify this explicit sextic polynomial,its constants,an ROC-only premise,the all-eta equivalence,or the uncorrected general-U density with that published theorem. Application retains the actual strictness,smoothness and growth hypotheses;no compatible transfer is asserted merely from the shared extension topic.
